ReviewText: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] As a content creator and media professional, having reliable audio equipment is important for reviewing footage, editing content, and monitoring sound during projects. The Sony ZX Series Wired On-Ear Headphones provide a simple and dependable option for everyday creative work. The lightweight design makes them comfortable for extended editing sessions, and the closed-back style helps reduce outside distractions when focusing on audio. The sound quality is clear for reviewing videos, podcasts, interviews, and social media content, especially considering the affordable price point. For my media workflow, these headphones are useful for: Checking audio levels during video editing Reviewing client projects before delivery Listening to reference tracks while creating content Everyday production tasks when traveling or working on location The wired connection is also a benefit because it eliminates Bluetooth delays and battery concerns when working with cameras, computers, or editing systems. While they are not designed as professional studio monitoring headphones for advanced audio mixing, they are a great budget-friendly tool for photographers, videographers, students, and creators who need reliable headphones without spending a lot. ReviewTitle: SONY ZX wired headset w/ microphone
ReviewText: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Unlike a wireless headset I recently purchased, these worked instantly and without any problems. The wireless headset worked only "hands free" which seems to be code for a phone and not for the internet. The length of the wire is OK but could be a wee bit longer, the audio is very good, and the price is excellent.

These headphones are clear and have decent bass for the price. Depth of soundstage and instrument separation are not as good as headphones in higher price brackets, but it is quite amazing what one can get these days at this price. They are decent for travel or desktop headphones when critical listening is not so important. Another positive aspect is that they do not clamp down on your ears which means you will not suffer as much from overheated/red ears after long periods of use. It lacks padding on the top headband and does not come with a carry case. But other than that, these will make great gifts to friends and family.
